notes.note: Reviewed the DiffPanel dependency integration delta against the workspace-surface claims and its real CodeView caller. The upgraded library supplies annotation, file/diff, then owning item; the callback now uses that third item and narrows diff annotations before reading side. Station still composes the shared read-only diff pane separately and preserves Project-scoped comment/reply submission. No prose change is needed: composition, read authority and repository semantics are unchanged. Existing real-library DiffPanel and DiffCommentThread tests pass (27), including opening/canceling/posting replies; the pre-fix DiffPanel run failed exactly those three reply tests. UI typecheck passes. No new browser or native rendering evidence is claimed.
